name: groundwork
description: A project-agnostic workflow that takes a software project from idea to MVP plan and keeps its documentation honest: BRD and functional-spec authoring, MVP scoping, functional spec gap-checks, an in-repo design package with ADRs, a machine-readable sprint plan, a go-live gate register, review gauntlet and drift audits. Works on greenfield projects and retrofits onto existing, undocumented codebases.
